sara: Quick heads-up 1: ran int6 bring-up for zephyrus-emb on staging. Recall@10 OK but Recall@1 on very short queries (<=6 tokens) down ~7pts vs float32.

devin: Oh no. Same whitening/norming?

sara: pipeline unchanged. I sliced the paraphrase adversarial set; paraphrase positives are losing top1 after quant.

lia: paste an example?

sara: example: "install node" -> pos: "setup nodejs" but nearest became "install python".

ajay: sounds like local neighbor jitter. Could be per-channel quant scale instability for small activations.

devin: I can repro locally with our CPU quant runtime. Snippet I ran attached.

sara: staging numbers: float32 R@1 0.84, int6 R@1 0.77; int6 R@10 0.92 (float32 0.93).

lia: R@10 intact suggests top1 swaps not global collapse.

ajay: experiments: (1) post-quant L2-normalize, (2) per-tensor vs per-channel calibration. Also UMAP float vs int6 for short queries.

sara: ran per-tensor + post-L2 as a quick smoke: R@1 0.82, R@10 0.915, nearest-swap rate down ~40% vs per-channel.

eval-bot: automation: started job zephyrus-int6-98312 tags [per-tensor,postnorm].

devin: good sign. Sara, can you run a larger paraphrase set and produce recall@1 by length bins (<=6,7-16,17+)? Lia, can you generate UMAP overlays and a small pivot of NN swaps?

lia: on it.

ajay: add onboarding checklist item: "paraphrase adversarial recall@1 by length bins".

sara: will update onboarding PR with failing examples, plots, and mitigation notes. Ping me if you want perf numbers before merging. :thumbsup:
